history.summary: Large freehold 3BR (1,432sqft) at $1,563 PSF, 340m from Hillview MRT (DTL) in D23, priced right on the $1,569 URA median. Strong resale-only appreciation of 6.5%/yr on a credible 22-txn series, with a generous spread-out floorplate.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely strong fundamentals for a value 3BR: freehold, 340m to Hillview MRT, $1,563 PSF at the URA median, and a clean resale-only 6.5%/yr CAGR backed by 22 transactions (not new-launch-biased). The $2.24M entry sits in a liquid family band. Caveat is age (1995, ~31yr) which lifts maintenance and slightly dampens resale velocity, but the large freehold floorplate near MRT is the durable appeal.
red_flags: Built 1995 (~31yr) — older fittings, higher maintenance, longer resale timeline
D23 Hillview is a quieter OCR sub-market with shallower buyer pool than RCR
catalysts: HillV2 / Rail Corridor / nature-fringe lifestyle draw

history.summary: Freehold 1995 3BR (1,432 sqft) 340m from Hillview MRT, asking $1,563 psf — verified exactly at the 12-month transacted average (~$1,571 psf, range $1,529-$1,614, SRX/99.co) and the URA median. Under current backtested priors the prior Buy collapses: the 6.5%/yr trailing CAGR has ~0 forward power and freehold is a level premium already in the price, not a return edge. What remains is the generic OCR/D23 forward prior vs a 31-year-old, thin-liquidity 184-unit estate at a $2.24M quantum — a fair-value hold, not an edge.
history.rating_rationale: Ask at the URA median / 12-mo average is fair value, not cheapness — the robust forward signal (cheap-vs-district-peers, age/size-adjusted) is absent. Prior Buy leaned on trailing 6.5% CAGR (22 txns) and freehold, both backtested ~0 forward edges. Positives: OCR region prior (+3.7%/yr realized fwd), 340m DTL access, genuine 22-txn comp base confirming the price is real (not a bait artifact). Negatives: 184 units with only ~5 sales Aug 2024-Jun 2025 (thin exit), 31-yr age/maintenance, $2.24M quantum on a 1,432 sqft 3BR narrows the D23 buyer pool, no en-bloc or area catalyst beyond existing HillV2/Rail Corridor amenity. Algo 318 overstates the negative but direction (no edge) agrees.
red_flags: Built 1995 (~31yr) — aging fittings, rising maintenance, dated facilities
Thin liquidity: 184-unit dev, ~5 transactions Aug 2024-Jun 2025 — slow exit on a 5-7yr horizon
$2.24M quantum for an OCR D23 3BR — shallow buyer pool for large old-freehold units
Ask at median = fair value; no cheap-vs-peers edge, the one robust forward signal
No en-bloc activity or process underway
catalysts: OCR/D23 region prior: realized forward ~+3.7%/yr, strongest regional baseline
340m to Hillview MRT (DTL) — durable transit premium
HillV2 / Rail Corridor / nature-fringe lifestyle draw (existing amenity, not new)
Long-shot freehold en-bloc optionality on a 1995 CDL site (no current activity)
